Record Class ModelInfoFile.Element

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.foundation.ike.model.ModelInfoFile.Element
Record Components:
name - the element's name
typeAsWritten - the type as the file writes it, or the nested specifier in CQL's syntax
type - the type, read
minimum - the least number of values, as written, empty when none
maximum - the most, as written, empty when none
prohibited - whether prohibited
mustSupport - whether an implementation must support it
oneBased - whether a list is counted from one
target - the element of another model it stands on, as written
label - the label
description - the short description
definition - the definition
comment - the comment
bindingName - the value set binding's name
bindingStrength - the binding's strength
bindingValueSet - the value set the binding names
Enclosing class:
ModelInfoFile

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
